items.title: Protein disulphide isomerase protects against ALS/FTD phenotypes associated with cyclin F in zebrafish and cellular models.
items.summary: Mutations in CCNF , encoding cyclin F, cause a small proportion of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) cases. Mutant cyclin F mislocalises from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, impairs the ubiquitin proteasome system, disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to Golgi transport, and triggers ER stress and apoptosis. Protein disulphide isomerase (PDI), a redox-active ER chaperone of the thioredoxin superfamily, protects against ALS phenotypes induced by mutant SOD1, TDP-43, and FUS, but its activity against mutant cyclin F has not been examined. To test whether PDI overexpression prevents the cellular and behavioural phenotypes induced by the ALS/FTD-associated cyclin F S621G mutation. Neuro-2a cells were co-transfected with mCherry-tagged wild-type or mutant cyclin F S621G and V5-tagged PDI or empty vector. Subcellular localisation, XBP-1 and CHOP activation, proteasome reporter (GFPu) accumulation, nuclear morphology, and cleaved caspase-3 immunoreactivity were assessed by confocal microscopy. Transient transgenic zebrafish larvae generated by mRNA co-injection of cyclin F and PDI were assessed by photomotor response at 48 h post-fertilisation. Mutant cyclin F S621G induced cytoplasmic mislocalisation, ER stress (assessed by XBP-1 and CHOP activation), proteasome dysfunction (indicated by GFPu accumulation), and apoptosis (assessed by nuclear condensation and caspase-3 activation), all of which were significantly attenuated by PDI co-expression. Zebrafish larvae expressing cyclin F S621G swam significantly shorter distances than uninjected or wildtype controls, and co-expression of PDI restored motor function to near-wildtype levels. PDI protects against ALS/FTD-associated mutant cyclin F in both cellular and in vivo zebrafish models, identifying PDI as a redox-based therapeutic target for CCNF -linked ALS/FTD.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶在斑马鱼和细胞模型中保护免受与细胞周期蛋白F相关的ALS/FTD表型影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究在Neuro-2a细胞和斑马鱼模型中测试了蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）对ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变的保护作用。结果显示，PDI共表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F引起的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和细胞凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼的游动距离。研究提示PDI是CCNF相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗靶点，但证据仅来自细胞和动物模型。
items.insight: CCNF突变是ALS/FTD的罕见但明确致病原因，目前缺乏针对性干预策略。该研究首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中验证PDI对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的保护作用，为CCNF相关ALS/FTD提供了基于氧化还原调控的候选靶点，值得关注后续能否在更接近人类的模型中验证并推进转化。

aiRead.studyType: 细胞与斑马鱼模型的机制研究
aiRead.keyFinding: PDI过表达可减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G引起的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼运动功能。
aiRead.limitation: 证据仅来自Neuro-2a细胞和瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型，尚未在哺乳动物体内或患者相关模型中验证，不能推断临床疗效。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注PDI在CCNF相关ALS/FTD哺乳动物模型中的验证、其氧化还原调控机制细节以及是否可发展为靶向干预策略。

items.abstractZh: 编码细胞周期蛋白F的CCNF基因突变导致一小部分肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。突变型细胞周期蛋白F从细胞核错误定位至细胞质，损害泛素蛋白酶体系统，破坏内质网（ER）至高尔基体运输，并触发内质网应激和细胞凋亡。蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）是硫氧还蛋白超家族中一种具有氧化还原活性的内质网伴侣蛋白，可保护免受突变型SOD1、TDP-43和FUS诱导的ALS表型，但其对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的活性尚未被研究。为检验PDI过表达是否能预防ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变诱导的细胞和行为表型。将Neuro-2a细胞与mCherry标记的野生型或突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G以及V5标记的PDI或空载体共转染。通过共聚焦显微镜评估亚细胞定位、XBP-1和CHOP激活、蛋白酶体报告基因（GFPu）积累、核形态和切割型caspase-3免疫反应性。通过受精后48小时的光运动反应评估由细胞周期蛋白F和PDI mRNA共注射产生的瞬时转基因斑马鱼幼鱼。突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导细胞质错误定位、内质网应激（通过XBP-1和CHOP激活评估）、蛋白酶体功能障碍（通过GFPu积累表明）和细胞凋亡（通过核浓缩和caspase-3激活评估），所有这些均被PDI共表达显著减弱。表达细胞周期蛋白F S621G的斑马鱼幼鱼游动距离显著短于未注射或野生型对照，而PDI共表达使运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。PDI在细胞和体内斑马鱼模型中均保护免受ALS/FTD相关突变型细胞周期蛋白F的影响，将PDI确定为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的基于氧化还原的治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近在细胞和斑马鱼模型中揭示PDI可对抗CCNF相关ALS/FTD表型，为这一罕见遗传亚型提供了具有转化潜力的氧化还原靶点。

items.title: Black Myrobalan ( Terminalia chebula ) as a potential multitarget neuroprotective agent: Translational insights and future directions in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Myrobalan or Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula Retz. ) has been integrated into Ayurvedic, Unani, and even Tibetan medicine systems for over 2000 years. The "King of Medicines" has traditionally been used for diverse ailments such as digestive issues, wound healing, and general body strengthening. Now, modern medicine is focusing on the myrobalan's potential neuroprotective properties and its use in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) neurodegenerative disorders. These ailments are characterized by some combination of enduring oxidative damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, irregular protein aggregation, and progressive neuron cell death. Most of the current treatment options revolve around addressing the symptoms of the diseases, which is insufficient as the underlying disease continues to progress. There is an urgent need to devise therapies that work simultaneously on multiple disease pathways. Some of the noted secondary metabolites in T. chebula include hydrolyzable tannins like chebulinic and chebulagic acid as well as corilagin. Others occur as phenolic acids such as gallic and ellagic acid and flavonoids quercetin and kaempferol. Moreover, glycosides, sterols, and a wide range of alkaloids are also present. A number of these compounds are known to possess multifunctional biological properties like scavenging ROS, activating Nrf2/ARE signaling, downregulating pro-inflammatory mediators through blockade of NF-κB, and exerting protective effects on the mitochondria, as well as modulating apoptosis via Bcl-2 and caspases. T. chebula extracts and some isolated compounds have also been shown to improve cognitive function, reduce neuroinflammation, and protect dopaminergic neurons, and ameliorate neurotoxic effects of amyloid-β or α-synuclein through in vitro and in vivo animal studies. A review of the contributions from the phytochemistry, mechanism of action, preclinical, translational, and adjunctive applications of Terminalia chebula in neurodegenerative disease therapy is presented here.

items.titleZh: 诃子（Terminalia chebula）作为潜在的多靶点神经保护剂：神经退行性疾病中的转化研究启示与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理诃子（Terminalia chebula）的植物化学成分及其在神经退行性疾病中的潜在神经保护作用。文章指出，诃子中的鞣质、酚酸、黄酮和生物碱等成分可清除活性氧、激活Nrf2/ARE通路、抑制NF-κB介导的神经炎症、保护线粒体并调节凋亡。体外和动物研究提示，诃子提取物及部分单体可改善认知、减轻神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并减轻β-淀粉样蛋白或α-突触核蛋白的毒性。文章强调目前治疗多为对症，亟需多靶点疗法，但现有证据主要来自临床前研究，尚未在ALS患者中证实疗效。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把诃子及其单体（如诃子酸、柯里拉京）定位为可同时干预氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集的多靶点候选物。虽然尚无ALS临床数据，但其机制覆盖ALS多个核心病理环节，且已有动物实验基础，可作为开发辅助治疗或联合用药策略的起点。研究者应关注后续是否开展ALS模型验证和早期临床试验。

aiRead.studyType: 叙述性综述，汇总植物化学、体外和动物研究证据
aiRead.keyFinding: 诃子提取物及诃子酸、柯里拉京等成分通过抗氧化、抗炎、线粒体保护和抗蛋白聚集等多靶点机制，在临床前模型中显示神经保护潜力，包括对ALS相关病理通路的覆盖。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏ALS患者临床数据，现有证据主要来自体外和动物研究；综述未提供定量疗效比较，成分标准化和生物利用度问题也未充分讨论。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注诃子单体或标准化提取物在ALS动物模型中的验证研究，以及是否推进到早期人体临床试验或辅助治疗试验。

items.abstractZh: 诃子（Myrobalan 或 Haritaki，学名 Terminalia chebula Retz.）已被整合进阿育吠陀、尤纳尼乃至藏医药体系超过2000年。这种“药物之王”传统上用于治疗多种疾病，如消化问题、伤口愈合和全身强壮。如今，现代医学正关注诃子的潜在神经保护特性及其在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）等神经退行性疾病中的应用。这些疾病以持续性氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症、异常蛋白聚集和进行性神经元细胞死亡中的若干组合为特征。目前大多数治疗方案围绕缓解疾病症状，这并不充分，因为 underlying 疾病仍在进展。迫切需要设计能同时作用于多条疾病通路的疗法。T. chebula 中一些值得注意的次级代谢产物包括可水解鞣质，如诃子酸（chebulinic acid）和诃黎勒酸（chebulagic acid）以及柯里拉京（corilagin）。其他则以酚酸形式存在，如没食子酸和鞣花酸，以及黄酮类槲皮素和山奈酚。此外，还含有糖苷、甾醇和多种生物碱。其中许多化合物已知具有多功能生物学特性，如清除ROS、激活Nrf2/ARE信号、通过阻断NF-κB下调促炎介质、对线粒体发挥保护作用，以及通过Bcl-2和caspases调节凋亡。T. chebula 提取物和一些分离化合物也已在体外和体内动物研究中显示可改善认知功能、减少神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并改善淀粉样蛋白-β或α-突触核蛋白的神经毒性作用。本文综述了 Terminalia chebula 在神经退行性疾病治疗中的植物化学、作用机制、临床前、转化和辅助应用方面的贡献。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了诃子多靶点神经保护机制与转化研究前景，直接关联ALS等神经退行性疾病的病理通路，但尚处临床前阶段，转化价值有待验证。

items.title: Engineered peroxisomes and patient-derived iPSC models as potential biomaterial platforms for precision neuroprotection in oxidative stress-driven central nervous system disorders.
items.summary: Peroxisomes couple hydrogen peroxide metabolism to lipid homeostasis, making their functions relevant to neurological disease and to the design of intracellular catalytic biomaterials. However, the strength of disease-specific evidence and the functions reproduced by current materials vary substantially. This narrative review distinguishes modified biological peroxisomes from artificial and biomimetic platforms and evaluates how patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) models could support their development. We examine membrane chemistry, substrate permeability, enzyme retention, catalytic activity, cell targeting, blood-brain barrier transport, three-dimensional tissue penetration, and intracellular fate. We separate the established causal role of peroxisomal defects in primary peroxisomal disorders from associative or unresolved findings in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Kleefstra syndrome is discussed as a hypothesis-generating neurodevelopmental model, without assuming a primary peroxisomal defect. Published artificial-organelle studies establish selected catalytic and delivery capabilities, but do not validate the integrated patient-specific CNS therapeutic strategy proposed here. We therefore outline a staged evaluation framework that combines materials characterization with mechanistic controls, differentiated neural cultures, multicellular models, animal pharmacology, safety, and manufacturing assessment. Comparison with conventional antioxidant carriers, plasmalogen supplementation, and PPAR agonists should determine whether compartmentalized catalysis offers a measurable advantage. We provide a platform classification, a disease-resolved evidence hierarchy, and a set of controls and measurable endpoints intended to make peroxisome-inspired constructs comparable across studies. Clinical development will require evidence of disease-relevant benefit beyond ROS reduction and an acceptable therapeutic window.
items.titleZh: 工程化过氧化物酶体与患者来源iPSC模型作为氧化应激驱动中枢神经系统疾病精准神经保护的潜在生物材料平台
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述系统梳理了工程化过氧化物酶体及仿生催化平台在氧化应激相关中枢神经系统疾病中的潜在应用。文章强调，过氧化物酶体缺陷在原发性过氧化物酶体病中有明确因果作用，但在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和ALS中多为关联性或未定论证据。作者提出利用患者iPSC模型评估这类生物材料，并建议分阶段验证框架，涵盖材料表征、机制对照、神经培养、动物药理、安全性和制造。文章指出，现有研究仅验证了部分催化与递送能力，尚未验证患者特异性治疗策略，临床转化需证明超越单纯降低ROS的疾病相关获益。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS领域提供了一个关键视角：过氧化物酶体功能与氧化应激在ALS中可能相关，但现有证据尚不足以确立因果。它提醒研究者在开发基于细胞器或仿生催化材料的神经保护策略时，必须严格区分原发性过氧化物酶体病与ALS等复杂疾病的证据等级，并利用患者iPSC模型进行机制验证和分层评估。其提出的分阶段评估框架和可比终点，有助于推动该方向从概念走向可重复的临床前研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 过氧化物酶体缺陷在原发性过氧化物酶体病中有因果作用，但在ALS等疾病中证据多为关联性；现有仿生催化平台仅验证部分功能，尚未验证患者特异性治疗策略。
aiRead.limitation: 为叙述性综述，未提供原始实验数据；对ALS等疾病的过氧化物酶体靶向治疗证据有限，所提框架尚待实证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续利用患者iPSC模型和动物模型验证过氧化物酶体启发构建体在ALS中疾病相关获益的研究，以及与传统抗氧化策略的头对头比较。

items.abstractZh: 过氧化物酶体将过氧化氢代谢与脂质稳态偶联，使其功能与神经系统疾病及细胞内催化生物材料的设计相关。然而，疾病特异性证据的强度以及当前材料所再现的功能差异很大。本叙述性综述区分了修饰的生物过氧化物酶体与人工及仿生平台，并评估了患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）模型如何支持其开发。我们考察了膜化学、底物通透性、酶保留、催化活性、细胞靶向、血脑屏障转运、三维组织穿透和细胞内命运。我们将过氧化物酶体缺陷在原发性过氧化物酶体病中的既定因果作用与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中的关联性或未解决发现区分开来。Kleefstra综合征作为假设生成性神经发育模型进行讨论，不假定存在原发性过氧化物酶体缺陷。已发表的人工细胞器研究确立了选定的催化和递送能力，但并未验证本文提出的整合患者特异性CNS治疗策略。因此，我们概述了一个分阶段评估框架，将材料表征与机制对照、分化神经培养、多细胞模型、动物药理学、安全性和制造评估相结合。与常规抗氧化载体、缩醛磷脂补充和PPAR激动剂的比较应确定区室化催化是否提供可测量的优势。我们提供了平台分类、疾病分辨的证据层级以及一套对照和可测量终点，旨在使过氧化物酶体启发的构建体在不同研究间具有可比性。临床开发将需要超越ROS降低的疾病相关获益证据和可接受的治疗窗。
items.frontierRationale: 该文新近提出将工程化过氧化物酶体与患者iPSC模型结合，为ALS等氧化应激相关神经疾病提供精准神经保护的材料学评估框架，具有转化方法学前沿性。

items.title: OGT regulates RNA-binding protein nucleocytoplasmic partitioning, but this fails in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: O-linked N-acetylglucosamine transferase (OGT) catalyzes the O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) modification to proteins and has been implicated in a range of diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a rapidly progressive and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder. However, the precise mechanisms by which OGT influences ALS pathogenesis remain largely unresolved. In this study, we used human-induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived spinal motor neurons (hiPSC-MNs), the principal cell type that undergoes degeneration in ALS, to systematically reveal that OGT-related mechanisms regulate RNA-binding protein (RBP) nucleocytoplasmic compartmentalization. Using a combination of antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) technology and small molecular pharmacology, we reveal two distinct regulatory mechanisms of RBP compartmentalization, including by intron-retaining transcript-mediated sequestration and O-linked N-acetylglucosaminylation (O-GlcNAcylation)-mediated nuclear transport. We finally examine the tractability of manipulating OGT activity in the ALS context but demonstrate that the OGT-related mechanisms governing RBP localization in healthy hiPSC-MNs are impaired in the context of ALS-causing VCP and TARDBP mutations.
items.titleZh: OGT调控RNA结合蛋白的核质分配，但在肌萎缩侧索硬化中这一机制失效
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用人诱导多能干细胞来源的脊髓运动神经元，发现OGT通过两种机制调控RNA结合蛋白在细胞核与细胞质之间的分布：内含子保留转录本的隔离作用和O-GlcNAc修饰介导的核转运。在携带ALS致病突变VCP和TARDBP的细胞中，这些调控机制出现障碍，提示OGT相关通路在ALS运动神经元中功能受损。
items.insight: 该研究将OGT介导的O-GlcNAc修饰与RNA结合蛋白核质定位障碍联系起来，为理解ALS中TDP-43等RBP异常聚集/错位提供了新的机制视角；同时提示在ALS突变背景下直接操纵OGT活性可能不足以纠正定位缺陷，对后续靶向O-GlcNAc通路的干预策略具有警示和指导意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: OGT相关机制通过内含子保留转录本隔离和O-GlcNAc修饰介导的核转运调控RBP核质区室化，而该机制在VCP和TARDBP突变背景下受损。

items.abstractZh: O-连接的N-乙酰葡糖胺转移酶（OGT）催化蛋白质的O-连接β-N-乙酰葡糖胺（O-GlcNAc）修饰，并已被认为与多种疾病相关，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）——一种快速进展且目前无法治愈的神经退行性疾病。然而，OGT影响ALS发病机制的确切机制在很大程度上仍未阐明。在本研究中，我们使用人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）来源的脊髓运动神经元（hiPSC-MNs）——ALS中发生变性的主要细胞类型——系统性地揭示了OGT相关机制调控RNA结合蛋白（RBP）的核质区室化。通过结合反义寡核苷酸（ASO）技术和小分子药理学，我们揭示了RBP区室化的两种不同调控机制，包括内含子保留转录本介导的隔离和O-连接N-乙酰葡糖胺化（O-GlcNAcylation）介导的核转运。我们最后检验了在ALS背景下操纵OGT活性的可操作性，但证明在健康hiPSC-MNs中 governing RBP定位的OGT相关机制在ALS致病性VCP和TARDBP突变背景下受损。
items.frontierRationale: 该细胞研究新近揭示了OGT调控RBP核质分配并在ALS致病突变下失效，为ALS中RNA代谢与O-GlcNAc修饰交叉领域提供了转化相关机制线索。

items.title: Novel compounds induce AChR clustering and improve motor function in myasthenia gravis animal models.
items.summary: The neuromuscular junction (NMJ), the synapse between motor nerves and skeletal muscles, is implicated in the pathogenesis of various neuromuscular disorders, including myasthenia gravis (MG), congenital myasthenia, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Postsynaptic clustering of acetylcholine receptors (AChRs) is crucial for NMJ formation. This process is initiated by agrin, a glycoprotein secreted from motor nerve terminals, which activates muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) via its coreceptor, low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 (Lrp4), and thereby activates downstream signaling pathways that induce AChR clustering. MG is an autoimmune disease characterized by the production of autoantibodies against NMJ components such as AChR, MuSK, and Lrp4, which leads to impaired neuromuscular transmission and motor dysfunction. In this study, we identified orally active small-molecule compounds that promote AChR clustering through the Lrp4-MuSK signaling axis. Knockdown experiments demonstrated that Lrp4 was responsible for the compounds to induce AChR clustering. The compounds induced MuSK phosphorylation following the compound treatment in C2C12 cells and improved motor function and increased muscle volume in both MuSK-MG mice and AChR-MG rat models. Together, these findings identify orally active small molecules that potentiate Lrp4-MuSK signaling and highlight a pharmacological strategy to modulate NMJ function for MG and related neuromuscular disorders.
items.titleZh: 新型化合物诱导AChR聚集并改善重症肌无力动物模型的运动功能
items.summaryZh: 研究者在细胞和两种重症肌无力动物模型中鉴定出一类口服小分子化合物，它们依赖Lrp4激活MuSK信号、促进乙酰胆碱受体聚集，并改善模型动物的运动功能和肌肉体积。该研究属于临床前药物发现，尚不能说明对人体有效。
items.insight: 该研究虽以重症肌无力为主要模型，但明确将NMJ形成与ALS等神经肌肉疾病联系起来，且靶向Lrp4-MuSK这一NMJ稳定性核心通路。对ALS研究者而言，它提供了一个可口服、可成药的突触后信号增强策略，值得关注其后续在ALS模型中的验证及安全性数据。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前基础研究（细胞实验与两种MG动物模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: 口服活性小分子依赖Lrp4促进AChR聚集、诱导MuSK磷酸化，并在MuSK-MG小鼠和AChR-MG大鼠中改善运动功能、增加肌肉体积。
aiRead.limitation: 证据仅来自C2C12细胞和MG动物模型，未在ALS模型或人体中验证，疗效与安全性尚未确立。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该类化合物在ALS动物模型中的NMJ保护作用、长期安全性及是否进入临床开发。

items.abstractZh: 神经肌肉接头（NMJ）是运动神经与骨骼肌之间的突触，参与多种神经肌肉疾病的发病机制，包括重症肌无力（MG）、先天性肌无力综合征和肌萎缩侧索硬化。突触后乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）聚集对NMJ形成至关重要。该过程由运动神经末梢分泌的糖蛋白agrin启动，agrin通过其共受体低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4（Lrp4）激活肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK），进而激活下游信号通路诱导AChR聚集。MG是一种自身免疫性疾病，其特征是产生针对NMJ组分（如AChR、MuSK和Lrp4）的自身抗体，导致神经肌肉传递受损和运动功能障碍。本研究鉴定出通过Lrp4-MuSK信号轴促进AChR聚集的口服活性小分子化合物。敲低实验证明Lrp4是这些化合物诱导AChR聚集所必需的。在C2C12细胞中，化合物处理后可诱导MuSK磷酸化；在MuSK-MG小鼠和AChR-MG大鼠模型中，化合物改善了运动功能并增加了肌肉体积。综上，这些发现鉴定出可增强Lrp4-MuSK信号的口服活性小分子，并提示了一种通过调节NMJ功能治疗MG及相关神经肌肉疾病的药理学策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定的口服小分子通过Lrp4-MuSK轴增强NMJ信号，具有向ALS等相关神经肌肉疾病转化的潜力。

items.title: Leuprorelin Acetate for Spinal and Bulbar Muscular Atrophy: A Systematic Review of Clinical Efficacy, Long-Term Outcomes, and Safety Considerations.
items.summary: Spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy (SBMA; Kennedy disease) is a rare X-linked neuromuscular disorder caused by a CAG repeat expansion in the androgen receptor gene. Leuprorelin acetate, a luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone agonist, suppresses androgen signaling and is approved for SBMA-associated dysphagia in Japan; however, evidence regarding efficacy remains heterogeneous. PubMed and Embase were searched from inception through June 18, 2026, for studies evaluating leuprorelin in genetically confirmed SBMA. Randomized trials, observational cohorts, natural history-controlled studies, extension studies, and safety case reports were included, and findings were synthesized narratively because of substantial heterogeneity. Eleven studies met inclusion criteria, including eight efficacy studies (460 patients) and three safety-focused case reports. Leuprorelin reduced pathogenic androgen receptor accumulation and improved biochemical markers, including serum creatine kinase and creatinine decline. Although neither pivotal randomized trial demonstrated significant short-term functional improvement at 48 weeks, longer-term studies showed slower decline in Revised Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Functional Rating Scale (ALSFRS-R), Limb Norris, and Norris Bulbar scores and improved event-free survival from pneumonia and death. Benefits were greatest with earlier treatment, particularly disease duration < 10 years. Leuprorelin was generally well tolerated; common adverse effects included hot flushes, sexual dysfunction, and decreased bone mineral density. Leuprorelin may slow long-term functional deterioration in SBMA, with greater benefit following early initiation and prolonged treatment.

items.titleZh: 醋酸亮丙瑞林治疗脊髓延髓肌萎缩症：临床疗效、长期结局与安全性考量的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 该系统综述汇总11项研究（含8项疗效研究、460例患者），提示醋酸亮丙瑞林虽未在两项关键随机试验的48周短期功能终点上显示显著改善，但较长期观察显示ALSFRS-R、Norris肢体及延髓评分下降更慢，肺炎和死亡的无事件生存期改善；病程短于10年者获益更明显。药物总体耐受良好，常见潮热、性功能障碍和骨密度下降。
items.insight: SBMA与ALS在延髓和肢体运动神经元退变上有重叠，且日本已批准亮丙瑞林用于SBMA相关吞咽困难，使其成为少见的“有机制、有长期信号、有监管先例”的神经肌肉疾病靶向治疗案例。其短期与长期终点分离、早期治疗获益更大的模式，对ALS试验的终点选择和干预窗口设计具有直接借鉴意义。

items.abstractZh: 脊髓延髓肌萎缩症（SBMA；肯尼迪病）是一种罕见的X连锁神经肌肉疾病，由雄激素受体基因CAG重复扩增引起。醋酸亮丙瑞林是一种促黄体生成素释放激素激动剂，可抑制雄激素信号传导，已在日本获批用于SBMA相关吞咽困难；然而其疗效证据仍存在异质性。检索PubMed和Embase自建库至2026年6月18日评估亮丙瑞林用于基因确诊SBMA的研究。纳入随机试验、观察性队列、自然病史对照研究、扩展研究及安全性病例报告，因异质性显著而采用叙述性综合。共11项研究符合纳入标准，包括8项疗效研究（460例患者）和3项安全性病例报告。亮丙瑞林减少致病性雄激素受体蓄积并改善生化标志物，包括血清肌酸激酶和肌酐下降。尽管两项关键随机试验均未在48周时显示显著的短期功能改善，但较长期研究显示修订版肌萎缩侧索硬化功能评定量表（ALSFRS-R）、肢体Norris评分和Norris延髓评分下降减慢，肺炎和死亡的无事件生存期改善。早期治疗获益最大，尤其是病程<10年者。亮丙瑞林总体耐受良好；常见不良反应包括潮热、性功能障碍和骨密度降低。亮丙瑞林可能减缓SBMA的长期功能恶化，早期起始和长期治疗获益更大。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年整合了亮丙瑞林在SBMA中的长期功能与生存信号，为ALS相关神经肌肉疾病的雄激素通路靶向干预和早期治疗窗口提供了新近的转化参考。

items.title: The calibration-to-accuracy mapping in P300 spellers does not transport across cohorts and was not restored by tested alignment or local recalibration.
items.summary: Objective. A calibration-derived score has been related to online P300-speller accuracy in the same session, always within the cohort measured. We evaluated whether a mapping from that score to expected accuracy transports to withheld cohorts. Approach. Retrospective secondary analysis of BigP3BCI 1.0.0, the largest evaluation of this relationship to date: 18 of 20 studies contributed 271 participants, 739 session-condition records, and 19 611 character selections. The predictor was a decoder's cross-validated discriminability on calibration epochs, one study withheld from development. Between-cohort variation was summarised by the random-effects standard deviation tau. Main results. The association was positive in all 18 cohorts but varied widely ( r 0.190-0.928; participant-level r = 0.714, p < 0.001), with 12 CIs excluding zero. Pooled estimation error was 0.098 (95% CI 0.091-0.107) against a benchmark of 0.146. Calibration did not transport: intercept tau 0.87 (unrepresented-cohort interval -1.97 to 1.85, log-odds); cohort-specific slopes varied more than tenfold (tau 0.43, interval 0.111-2.005). Neither alignment (signal- or score-space) nor either nonlinear boundary meaningfully reduced this heterogeneity. Local recalibration with up to 16 participants did not reliably improve on transporting; refitting both intercept and slope was significantly worse than transporting at the smallest sizes. Median time per selection, a stopping-rule proxy, accounted for 66% of between-cohort slope variance in meta-regression. The four amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) cohorts gave an uncorrected slope spread of 0.223, against 0.560 overall. Significance. The evaluated score is a classifier's cross-validated discriminability on each session's calibration data rather than the source studies' undocumented online decoder. That score reproducibly signals within-session accuracy, but its mapping to accuracy is cohort-specific and supports ranking sessions after local validation rather than reporting accuracy elsewhere. The four-cohort ALS subgroup appeared more homogeneous than the full archive, illustrating how conclusions about transportability from a small cohort set can be fragile.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（回顾性二次分析）
items.titleZh: P300拼写器中的校准-准确度映射无法跨队列迁移，且经测试的对齐或局部重校准均未能恢复该映射
items.summaryZh: 该研究基于迄今最大的P300拼写器数据集（18项研究、271名参与者、19611次字符选择）进行回顾性分析，发现校准阶段解码器判别力虽能在同一队列内正向预测在线拼写准确度，但该映射关系无法迁移到其他队列：不同队列的截距和斜率差异显著，且信号空间/评分空间对齐及非线性边界均未能有效降低异质性。局部重校准在样本量较小时甚至劣于直接迁移。四个ALS队列的斜率变异小于总体，提示小队列得出的可迁移性结论可能不稳定。
items.insight: 对ALS脑机接口研究者而言，这项研究提示：不能将某一队列中建立的校准-准确度映射直接外推至ALS患者群体；在报告P300拼写器准确度或进行跨研究比较前，需在目标队列内进行局部验证。同时，ALS亚组表现出的相对同质性值得进一步在更大ALS队列中验证，以避免因样本量小而产生误导性结论。

aiRead.studyType: 回顾性二次分析（BigP3BCI 1.0.0数据集，18项研究、271名参与者、739条会话-条件记录、19611次字符选择）
aiRead.keyFinding: 校准衍生评分在同一队列内可重复指示P300拼写器会话内准确度，但其与准确度的映射具有队列特异性，无法跨队列迁移；对齐与局部重校准均未能有效恢复迁移性；四个ALS队列的斜率变异小于总体。
aiRead.limitation: 为回顾性二次分析，所评估的评分为分类器交叉验证判别力而非源研究在线解码器；ALS亚组仅四个队列，样本代表性有限；局部重校准在最小样本量下效果不佳。
aiRead.watchNext: 在更大规模、多中心的ALS队列中验证校准-准确度映射的异质性来源，并探索结合停止规则代理指标（如每次选择中位时间）的队列自适应校准策略。

items.abstractZh: 目的。校准衍生的评分已在同一会话内与在线P300拼写器准确度相关联，且始终局限于所测量的队列内。我们评估了将该评分映射到预期准确度的关系能否迁移至留出队列。方法。对BigP3BCI 1.0.0进行回顾性二次分析，这是迄今对该关系规模最大的评估：20项研究中的18项贡献了271名参与者、739条会话-条件记录和19611次字符选择。预测变量为解码器在校准epoch上的交叉验证判别力，其中一项研究被留出用于开发。队列间变异以随机效应标准差tau汇总。主要结果。该关联在全部18个队列中均为正向，但变异很大（r 0.190-0.928；参与者水平r=0.714，p<0.001），其中12个置信区间排除零。合并估计误差为0.098（95% CI 0.091-0.107），对照基准为0.146。校准未能迁移：截距tau为0.87（未代表队列区间-1.97至1.85，对数几率）；队列特异性斜率变异超过十倍（tau 0.43，区间0.111-2.005）。无论是信号空间还是评分空间的对齐，以及两种非线性边界，均未显著降低这种异质性。使用最多16名参与者的局部重校准未能可靠优于迁移；在最小样本量下，同时重新拟合截距和斜率显著劣于迁移。每次选择的中位时间作为停止规则的代理指标，在元回归中解释了队列间斜率方差的66%。四个肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）队列给出的未校正斜率跨度为0.223，而总体为0.560。意义。所评估的评分是分类器在每次会话校准数据上的交叉验证判别力，而非源研究中未记录的在线解码器。该评分可重复地指示会话内准确度，但其与准确度的映射具有队列特异性，支持在局部验证后对会话进行排序，而非在其他地方报告准确度。四队列ALS亚组似乎比完整档案更同质，说明从小队列集得出的可迁移性结论可能较为脆弱。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用迄今最大的P300拼写器数据集（含四个ALS队列）系统检验校准-准确度映射的跨队列可迁移性，对ALS脑机接口的临床验证与结果报告规范具有直接转化意义。

items.title: The decline of respiratory function in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients and the role of non-invasive ventilation.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a chronic neurodegenerative disease characterized by a poor prognosis, with an average survival of 3 to 5 years from symptom onset. Respiratory failure is the main cause of death, and non-invasive ventilation (NIV) is a cornerstone in the management of ALS patients. This single-center retrospective study was conducted at Siena University Hospital between 2010 and 2024 to analyze respiratory function parameters in ALS patients undergoing NIV, stratified by disease severity and followed over one year, to assess the relationship between lung function decline and the timing of NIV initiation. A total of 49 patients (29 males, 20 females; mean age 67±12 years) were enrolled, and 31 (63%) received NIV. Clinical and functional parameters, including forced vital capacity (FVC), pCO₂, respiratory symptoms at baseline, and longitudinal measurements of sitting FVC (FVCsit%), supine FVC (FVCsup%), and pCO₂, were collected and analyzed over time. Differences in FVC decline were observed according to the timing of NIV initiation. Among non-severe patients, those starting NIV at T0 showed a 22.5% reduction in FVC over a mean follow-up of 12.8±4.8 months. Patients initiating NIV at T2 exhibited a reported FVCsit decline of 26% (p=0.0488) and a survival of 51.3±50 months from NIV initiation, whereas those starting later (T3-T6) showed a greater decline (FVCsit decline 34%, p=0.0002) and shorter survival duration (15.7±28.6 months). These findings describe differences in respiratory function trajectories and observed survival among patients initiating NIV at different follow-up time points. However, the retrospective design, small sample size, baseline differences between groups, and potential confounding and survival-related selection bias limit causal interpretation. Further studies are needed to clarify the relationship between NIV initiation timing and clinical outcomes in ALS.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（单中心回顾性队列）
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者呼吸功能下降与无创通气的作用
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心回顾性研究分析了49例ALS患者的呼吸功能数据，其中31例接受无创通气。研究按疾病严重程度分层并随访约一年，比较了不同时间点启动无创通气患者的用力肺活量下降轨迹和生存情况。结果显示，较晚启动无创通气者肺功能下降更明显、生存期更短，但受回顾性设计、样本量小和组间基线差异等限制，不能据此推断因果关系。
items.insight: 无创通气是ALS呼吸管理的关键手段，但启动时机对呼吸功能轨迹和生存的影响尚缺乏统一标准。该研究提供了真实世界纵向数据，提示启动时机可能与肺功能下降速度和生存相关，值得关注后续前瞻性研究能否验证并转化为可操作的启动阈值。

aiRead.studyType: 单中心回顾性观察性研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 较晚启动无创通气的ALS患者坐位用力肺活量下降幅度更大且自启动起生存期更短，但组间基线差异和选择偏倚限制因果推断。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、样本量小（49例）、组间基线差异、潜在混杂及与生存相关的选择偏倚。
aiRead.watchNext: 需前瞻性多中心研究验证无创通气启动时机与呼吸功能轨迹及生存的因果关系，并探索可操作的启动阈值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种以预后不良为特征的慢性神经退行性疾病，从症状出现起平均生存期为3至5年。呼吸衰竭是主要死亡原因，无创通气（NIV）是ALS患者管理的基石。这项单中心回顾性研究于2010年至2024年在锡耶纳大学医院开展，旨在分析接受NIV的ALS患者的呼吸功能参数，按疾病严重程度分层并随访一年，以评估肺功能下降与NIV启动时机之间的关系。共纳入49例患者（男29例，女20例；平均年龄67±12岁），其中31例（63%）接受了NIV。收集并分析了临床和功能参数，包括用力肺活量（FVC）、pCO₂、基线呼吸症状，以及坐位FVC（FVCsit%）、仰卧位FVC（FVCsup%）和pCO₂的纵向测量值。根据NIV启动时机观察到FVC下降的差异。在非重症患者中，于T0启动NIV者在平均12.8±4.8个月随访期内FVC下降22.5%。于T2启动NIV的患者报告FVCsit下降26%（p=0.0488），自NIV启动起生存期为51.3±50个月；而较晚启动者（T3-T6）下降幅度更大（FVCsit下降34%，p=0.0002），生存期更短（15.7±28.6个月）。这些发现描述了在不同随访时间点启动NIV的患者之间呼吸功能轨迹和观察到的生存差异。然而，回顾性设计、样本量小、组间基线差异以及潜在混杂和与生存相关的选择偏倚限制了因果解释。需要进一步研究以阐明NIV启动时机与ALS临床结局之间的关系。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用2010至2024年的纵向真实世界数据，聚焦无创通气启动时机与ALS呼吸功能下降轨迹的关系，具有近期临床转化参考价值。

items.title: Brain clearance of protein aggregates in degenerative diseases: the role of microglia and astrocytes.
items.summary: Protein aggregation and impaired clearance constitute central pathological hallmarks of numerous neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and frontotemporal dementia. Misfolded proteins, both extracellular and intracellular, disrupt proteostasis and contribute to synaptic dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and neuronal loss. Within the central nervous system, glial cells serve as the primary mediators of pathological protein clearance. Microglia detect, phagocytose, and degrade aggregated proteins. However, under chronic pathological stress, microglial function turns from clearing pathological proteins to paradoxically facilitating their spread. Astrocytes, which provide metabolic and homeostatic support for neurons, also participate in the clearance of aggregates through phagocytosis and glymphatic drainage. Critically, crosstalk between astrocytes and microglia enhances the clearance: microglia can recruit and process aggregates internalized by astrocytes, while astrocyte-derived signals modulate the microglial phagocytic activity. Aging, genetic risk factors, or sustained neuroinflammation may reduce the efficiency of glial removal of aggregates and accelerate disease progression. Understanding the cellular and molecular underpinnings of microglial and astrocytic clearance pathways is essential for developing therapies aimed at restoring proteostasis and mitigating neurodegeneration.
items.titleZh: 退行性疾病中蛋白聚集物的脑内清除：小胶质细胞与星形胶质细胞的作用
items.summaryZh: 该综述指出，蛋白聚集与清除障碍是ALS等神经退行性疾病的共同核心病理。小胶质细胞负责识别、吞噬和降解聚集蛋白，但在慢性病理应激下可能转而促进聚集物扩散；星形胶质细胞通过吞噬和类淋巴引流参与清除，并与小胶质细胞形成协同清除网络。衰老、遗传风险和持续神经炎症会削弱胶质细胞清除效率，加速疾病进展。文章强调，理解这两类胶质细胞清除通路的细胞和分子机制，是开发恢复蛋白稳态、减缓神经退行性变疗法的基础。
items.insight: ALS研究日益关注非细胞自主机制，其中胶质细胞对病理性蛋白聚集物的清除能力可能直接影响疾病起始与扩散。该综述系统梳理了小胶质细胞与星形胶质细胞在聚集物清除中的分工、协同及功能逆转，为理解ALS中蛋白稳态失衡和神经炎症的交互提供了框架，并提示胶质细胞清除通路可能成为干预靶点。

aiRead.studyType: 综述（动物/细胞实验证据整合）
aiRead.keyFinding: 小胶质细胞与星形胶质细胞协同清除蛋白聚集物，但慢性应激下小胶质细胞可能促进聚集物扩散，衰老和神经炎症会削弱清除效率。
aiRead.limitation: 为综述性总结，未提供新的原始实验数据，所整合证据多来自动物或细胞研究，向临床转化仍需验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对小胶质细胞-星形胶质细胞清除轴的具体分子靶点研究，以及恢复胶质细胞清除功能在ALS模型中的干预效果。

items.abstractZh: 蛋白聚集和清除受损是包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶痴呆在内的多种神经退行性疾病的中心病理标志。错误折叠蛋白，无论位于细胞外还是细胞内，都会破坏蛋白稳态，并导致突触功能障碍、神经炎症和神经元丢失。在中枢神经系统中，胶质细胞是病理性蛋白清除的主要介导者。小胶质细胞能够识别、吞噬并降解聚集蛋白。然而，在慢性病理应激下，小胶质细胞的功能会从清除病理性蛋白转变为反常地促进其扩散。星形胶质细胞为神经元提供代谢和稳态支持，也通过吞噬作用和类淋巴引流参与聚集物的清除。关键的是，星形胶质细胞与小胶质细胞之间的交互作用可增强清除：小胶质细胞能够招募并处理星形胶质细胞吞入的聚集物，而星形胶质细胞来源的信号可调节小胶质细胞的吞噬活性。衰老、遗传风险因素或持续的神经炎症可能降低胶质细胞清除聚集物的效率，并加速疾病进展。理解小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞清除通路的细胞与分子基础，对于开发旨在恢复蛋白稳态和减轻神经退行性变的疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，聚焦小胶质细胞与星形胶质细胞协同清除蛋白聚集物这一新近受到关注的机制，与ALS蛋白稳态和神经炎症病理高度相关，并具有指导清除通路靶点开发的转化价值。

items.title: The TNKS/PI31-proteasome axis as a central node in TDP-43 neuropathies.
items.summary: Pathological aggregation of Tar DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) and disruption of neuronal protein homeostasis are defining features of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD), and related TDP-43 proteinopathies. Efficient axonal transport of proteasomes is essential for maintaining local protein quality control in neurons. Proteasome inhibitor 31 (PI31) regulates both 26S proteasome assembly and dynein-mediated transport of 20S proteasomes. Although Tankyrase 1/2 (TNKS)-mediated ADP-ribosylation of PI31 promotes 26S proteasome assembly, its role in proteasome transport and its contribution to TDP-43 pathology remain unclear. Live-cell imaging was performed to examine 20S proteasome transport in primary cortical and motor neurons from wild-type and Prp-TDP-43 A315T transgenic mice. Protein interactions among TDP-43, TNKS, and PI31 were analyzed by immunoprecipitation and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET). Insoluble protein accumulation and colocalization were assessed by RIPA/urea fractionation, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence. Proteasome assembly and activity were evaluated using native gel electrophoresis and a 20S proteasome-specific fluorogenic substrate. TDP-43 aggregation was examined by semi-denaturing detergent agarose gel electrophoresis (SDD-AGE). In cell models expressing TDP-43-FL, TDP-43-A315T, or TDP-25 and in Prp-TDP-43 A315T transgenic mice, pathological TDP-43 species formed distinct aggregates, ranging from oligomers to prominent cytoplasmic aggregates, yet all reduced proteasome activity, impaired axonal proteasome transport, and caused the accumulation of polyubiquitinated proteins, PI31, 20S proteasomes, and TDP-43 in the proximal axon and cell body. Pathological TDP-43 sequestered TNKS and proteasome components into insoluble fractions, thereby limiting the availability of free and soluble TNKS for interaction with PI31 and subsequent PI31 ADP-ribosylation, ultimately impairing 19S/20S proteasome assembly. Notably, disruption of the TNKS-PI31 interaction or inhibition of TNKS activity recapitulated the proteasome dysfunction induced by pathological TDP-43, supporting a role for the aberrant TNKS-TDP-43 interaction and consequent impairment of TNKS-mediated PI31 ADP-ribosylation in TNKS/PI31/proteasome axis dysfunction. Pathological TDP-43 disrupts proteasome function by impairing the TNKS/PI31/proteasome axis, suggesting that this axis may represent a potential therapeutic target for TDP-43 proteinopathies. Selectively restoring this pathway may enhance pathological TDP-43 clearance while minimizing nonspecific proteasome activation, thereby providing a more precise and safer therapeutic strategy for ALS and FTLD.
items.titleZh: TNKS/PI31-蛋白酶体轴作为TDP-43神经病变的核心节点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞模型和TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠中揭示：病理性TDP-43聚集会 sequestration TNKS和蛋白酶体组分进入不溶性部分，减少可溶性TNKS与PI31的相互作用及PI31 ADP-核糖基化，进而损害19S/20S蛋白酶体组装、轴突蛋白酶体运输和蛋白酶体活性，导致多泛素化蛋白和TDP-43在近端轴突和胞体积累。破坏TNKS-PI31相互作用或抑制TNKS可重现上述蛋白酶体功能障碍。作者提出选择性恢复TNKS/PI31/蛋白酶体轴可能促进病理性TDP-43清除，是ALS/FTLD的潜在治疗方向。
items.insight: 该研究把TDP-43病理与蛋白酶体轴突运输和组装缺陷通过TNKS/PI31轴联系起来，提出了一个可干预的分子节点。对ALS研究者而言，值得跟踪的是：该轴是否在人类ALS/FTLD组织中得到验证，以及选择性调节TNKS/PI31是否能在动物模型中改善TDP-43清除和运动神经元存活，而不引起广泛蛋白酶体激活的副作用。

aiRead.studyType: 基础研究（细胞模型与转基因小鼠）
aiRead.keyFinding: 病理性TDP-43通过隔离TNKS、减少PI31 ADP-核糖基化而损害19S/20S蛋白酶体组装和轴突运输，破坏TNKS/PI31/蛋白酶体轴。
aiRead.limitation: 证据来自细胞和TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠模型，尚需人类ALS/FTLD组织验证及体内靶向干预的安全性和有效性评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该轴在人类TDP-43蛋白病中的验证，以及选择性恢复TNKS/PI31通路能否在动物模型中促进病理性TDP-43清除并改善神经元功能。

items.abstractZh: TDP-43的病理性聚集和神经元蛋白稳态的破坏是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、额颞叶变性（FTLD）及相关TDP-43蛋白病的标志性特征。蛋白酶体的高效轴突运输对于维持神经元局部蛋白质质量控制至关重要。蛋白酶体抑制剂31（PI31）既调控26S蛋白酶体的组装，也调控动力蛋白介导的20S蛋白酶体运输。尽管端锚聚合酶1/2（TNKS）介导的PI31 ADP-核糖基化可促进26S蛋白酶体组装，但其在蛋白酶体运输中的作用及对TDP-43病理的贡献仍不清楚。研究采用活细胞成像检测野生型和Prp-TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠原代皮层和运动神经元中的20S蛋白酶体运输；通过免疫沉淀和荧光共振能量转移（FRET）分析TDP-43、TNKS和PI31之间的蛋白相互作用；通过RIPA/尿素分级分离、Western blotting和免疫荧光评估不溶性蛋白积累和共定位；使用天然凝胶电泳和20S蛋白酶体特异性荧光底物评估蛋白酶体组装和活性；通过半变性去垢剂琼脂糖凝胶电泳（SDD-AGE）检测TDP-43聚集。在表达TDP-43-FL、TDP-43-A315T或TDP-25的细胞模型及Prp-TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠中，病理性TDP-43种类形成从寡聚体到明显胞质聚集体的不同聚集体，但均降低蛋白酶体活性、损害轴突蛋白酶体运输，并导致多泛素化蛋白、PI31、20S蛋白酶体和TDP-43在近端轴突和胞体中积累。病理性TDP-43将TNKS和蛋白酶体组分隔离至不溶性组分中，从而限制游离可溶性TNKS与PI31相互作用及随后的PI31 ADP-核糖基化，最终损害19S/20S蛋白酶体组装。值得注意的是，破坏TNKS-PI31相互作用或抑制TNKS活性可重现病理性TDP-43诱导的蛋白酶体功能障碍，支持异常的TNKS-TDP-43相互作用及随之而来的TNKS介导PI31 ADP-核糖基化受损在TNKS/PI31/蛋白酶体轴功能障碍中发挥作用。病理性TDP-43通过损害TNKS/PI31/蛋白酶体轴破坏蛋白酶体功能，提示该轴可能成为TDP-43蛋白病的潜在治疗靶点。选择性恢复该通路可能增强病理性TDP-43清除，同时尽量减少非特异性蛋白酶体激活，从而为ALS和FTLD提供更精确、更安全的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究在TDP-43蛋白病模型中揭示TNKS/PI31-蛋白酶体轴这一可干预节点，具有ALS机制转化价值。

items.title: Advances in plant polysaccharide research for neurodegenerative diseases therapy.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs), including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Huntington's disease (HD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and multiple sclerosis (MS), represent a growing global public health burden with limited therapeutic options. Plant polysaccharides are natural, biocompatible, and multi-target bioactive macromolecules that have emerged as promising candidates for ND intervention. This review systematically summarizes recent progress in elucidating the structural characteristics, structure-activity relationships, and neuroprotective mechanisms of plant polysaccharides. Key structural features such as molecular weight, monosaccharide composition, glycosidic bond configuration, and spatial conformation critically modulate the biological activity of these molecules. Furthermore, we summarize the numerous protective effects of plant polysaccharides against NDs, including inhibiting abnormal protein aggregation, alleviating oxidative stress via the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, suppressing neuroinflammation through the NF-κB and MAPK signaling pathways, regulating neuronal apoptosis, and modulating the gut-brain axis. Clinical translation challenges, primarily blood-brain barrier penetration, structural heterogeneity, and insufficient clinical validation, are discussed. Future directions include developing advanced delivery systems, conducting large-scale randomized controlled trials, and exploring synergistic combination therapies. Collectively, plant polysaccharides show considerable promise as potential multi-target candidates for the intervention of NDs, although further studies are needed to clarify their therapeutic potential and facilitate clinical translation.

items.titleZh: 植物多糖治疗神经退行性疾病的研究进展
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理植物多糖的结构特征（分子量、单糖组成、糖苷键构型、空间构象）与其神经保护活性的关系，并归纳其在AD、PD、HD、ALS、MS等神经退行性疾病中的潜在作用机制，包括抑制蛋白异常聚集、经Nrf2/HO-1通路抗氧化、经NF-κB/MAPK通路抗神经炎症、调节神经元凋亡及调控肠-脑轴。文章同时指出血脑屏障穿透、结构异质性和临床验证不足是转化瓶颈，提出递送系统优化、大规模随机对照试验和联合治疗等未来方向。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，本文的价值在于把植物多糖这一天然多靶点分子与ALS相关的蛋白稳态、氧化应激、神经炎症和肠-脑轴等病理环节联系起来，并明确血脑屏障穿透和临床证据不足是主要障碍。它可作为评估天然产物类候选干预、设计联合方案和递送策略的背景参考，但不代表已有临床疗效证据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 植物多糖通过抑制蛋白聚集、Nrf2/HO-1抗氧化、NF-κB/MAPK抗炎、调节凋亡和肠-脑轴等多机制发挥神经保护潜力，但血脑屏障穿透、结构异质性和临床验证不足限制转化。
aiRead.limitation: 为综述而非原始临床研究，未提供新的ALS患者疗效数据；原文证据分类标注与内容不符，不能据此认为疗效已获随机对照试验证实。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注植物多糖递送系统（尤其跨血脑屏障策略）的进展，以及针对ALS等神经退行性疾病的大规模随机对照试验和联合治疗研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDs），包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、亨廷顿病（HD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和多发性硬化（MS），构成日益增长的全球公共卫生负担，且治疗选择有限。植物多糖是天然、生物相容且多靶点的生物活性大分子，已成为ND干预的有前景候选物。本综述系统总结了植物多糖结构特征、构效关系及神经保护机制的最新进展。分子量、单糖组成、糖苷键构型及空间构象等关键结构特征可关键性调节这些分子的生物活性。此外，我们总结了植物多糖对NDs的多种保护作用，包括抑制异常蛋白聚集、通过Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解氧化应激、通过NF-κB和MAPK信号通路抑制神经炎症、调节神经元凋亡以及调控肠-脑轴。本文讨论了临床转化挑战，主要是血脑屏障穿透、结构异质性及临床验证不足。未来方向包括开发先进递送系统、开展大规模随机对照试验以及探索协同联合治疗。总体而言，植物多糖作为ND干预的潜在多靶点候选物显示出可观前景，但仍需进一步研究以阐明其治疗潜力并促进临床转化。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了植物多糖多靶点干预神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）的结构与机制证据，并指出血脑屏障递送和临床验证是转化关键。

items.title: Integrative spatial metallomics: a tutorial review of multimodal elemental imaging workflows, challenges and opportunities.
items.summary: Spatially resolved molecular assays are increasingly used to study human health and disease, revealing complex tissue organization beyond what is accessible through bulk analyses. While spatial transcriptomic, metabolomic, and proteomic approaches have rapidly matured, quantitative mapping of metals and trace elements in biological tissues and biominerals through elemental imaging remains comparatively nascent. Elemental distributions alone often provide limited biological interpretation without contextualization within the tissue microenvironment. Here, we summarize themes and computational strategies for integrating spatial elemental data with histopathology and complementary spatial molecular assays. We highlight multimodal approaches for tissue alignment, pixel-wise clustering, and correlative analysis, illustrated through limited use cases involving amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and kidney stone formation. In the ALS cohort, pixel-level elemental profiles were clustered and compared with annotated tissue structures. In the kidney stone cohort, spatial gradients and correlations in elemental and biomolecular features from the renal papilla through the medulla to cortex were examined. Finally, we discuss key challenges for cross-sample, cohort-level analyses, including differences in spatial resolution, normalization, tissue architecture, and mechanistic inference. Addressing these challenges will require interdisciplinary collaboration, enhanced biobanking practices, and development of computational and statistical frameworks.

items.titleZh: 整合空间金属组学：多模态元素成像工作流、挑战与机遇的教程综述
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇方法学教程综述，系统梳理如何将空间元素成像（金属与微量元素分布）与组织病理学及其他空间分子检测整合分析。文中以 ALS 和肾结石为有限示例：ALS 部分对像素级元素谱进行聚类并与标注组织结构比对；肾结石部分分析从肾乳头到皮质的元素与生物分子空间梯度。作者指出，跨样本和队列水平整合仍面临分辨率、归一化、组织结构差异和机制推断等挑战，需跨学科协作与计算统计框架支持。
items.insight: ALS 研究长期缺乏对金属/微量元素在组织原位分布的系统刻画，而铁、锌、铜等金属稳态与 ALS 机制密切相关。这篇综述提供的多模态配准、像素级聚类与相关分析流程，可作为将元素成像纳入 ALS 组织病理研究的方法学参考，但其 ALS 用例仅为示例性观察，不构成临床或机制结论。

items.abstractZh: 空间分辨分子检测正越来越多地用于研究人类健康与疾病，揭示出 bulk 分析无法呈现的复杂组织结构。尽管空间转录组学、代谢组学和蛋白质组学方法已迅速成熟，但通过元素成像对生物组织和生物矿物中的金属及微量元素进行定量映射仍相对处于起步阶段。元素分布本身若不在组织微环境中加以情境化，往往只能提供有限的生物学解释。本文总结了将空间元素数据与组织病理学及互补空间分子检测相整合的主题与计算策略。我们重点介绍了用于组织对齐、像素级聚类和相关分析的多模态方法，并通过涉及肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和肾结石形成的有限用例加以说明。在 ALS 队列中，对像素级元素谱进行了聚类，并与标注的组织结构进行比较。在肾结石队列中，考察了从肾乳头经髓质到皮质的元素与生物分子特征的空间梯度和相关性。最后，我们讨论了跨样本、队列水平分析的关键挑战，包括空间分辨率、归一化、组织结构及机制推断方面的差异。应对这些挑战需要跨学科合作、改进的生物样本库实践以及计算和统计框架的开发。
items.frontierRationale: 新近系统梳理空间金属组学与空间分子检测的多模态整合流程，并直接以 ALS 组织为示例，对推动 ALS 金属稳态研究的可重复空间分析具有转化方法学价值。

items.title: Protein Isoaspartate Repair in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: An Integrative Bioinformatic Analysis of the PCMT Gene Family.
items.summary: Protein homeostasis is a fundamental determinant of neuronal survival, and its disruption contributes to the pathogenesis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Protein L-isoaspartate O-methyltransferases (PCMTs) are evolutionarily conserved proteins involved in the recognition and processing of damaged proteins through the repair of isoaspartyl residues and protein quality-control pathways; however, their potential involvement in ALS remains largely unexplored. Here, we performed a comprehensive in silico characterization of the PCMT family (PCMT1, PCMTD1, and PCMTD2) by integrating structural, transcriptomic, single-cell, genetic, and protein modeling analyses. Domain analysis demonstrated that all three proteins share a conserved PCMT domain, while predicted S-adenosylmethionine-binding motifs were identified in PCMT1 and PCMTD2 but not PCMTD1, indicating evolutionary conservation with functional divergence. Expression profiling revealed that PCMT family genes are expressed in ALS-relevant tissues and broadly distributed across neuronal, glial, vascular, and immune cell populations in both healthy and ALS-associated brain single-cell data sets. Analysis of multiple independent ALS transcriptomic cohorts identified consistent upregulation of PCMT family members, with PCMTD1 exhibiting the most reproducible disease-associated expression changes across nervous system tissues and peripheral blood. Gene set correlation analyses further revealed distinct relationships between PCMT expression and neuronal pathways, with PCMT1 showing positive associations with axonal transport and synaptic signaling, whereas PCMTD1 and PCMTD2 displayed largely inverse correlation patterns. Rare missense variants identified in ALS patients were predicted to impair protein function and decrease protein stability, while structural modeling suggested that several substitutions may disrupt conserved residues and the local protein architecture. Collectively, these findings identify the PCMT family as previously underexplored candidates associated with ALS and provide a comprehensive framework for future mechanistic studies investigating their roles in neuronal protein homeostasis and neurodegeneration.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的蛋白质异天冬氨酸修复：PCMT基因家族的综合生物信息学分析
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过生物信息学方法整合结构、转录组、单细胞、遗传和蛋白质建模数据，系统分析PCMT基因家族（PCMT1、PCMTD1、PCMTD2）与ALS的关联。结果显示三个基因在ALS相关组织及多种脑细胞类型中表达，多个独立ALS队列中PCMT家族成员一致上调，其中PCMTD1变化最可重复；PCMT1表达与轴突运输和突触信号正相关，而PCMTD1/PCMTD2呈反向相关；患者中罕见错义变异被预测损害蛋白功能与稳定性。研究提示PCMT家族是ALS中未被充分探索的候选基因，但均为计算预测，尚需实验验证。
items.insight: 该研究将蛋白质异天冬氨酸修复这一蛋白质质量控制机制与ALS联系起来，提出了PCMT家族作为潜在候选基因，尤其是PCMTD1在多个独立队列中表现出一致的表达变化，为ALS蛋白质稳态研究提供了新的可检验假设。但研究完全基于生物信息学预测，无实验功能验证，结论应视为假设生成而非机制确立。

items.abstractZh: 蛋白质稳态是神经元存活的基本决定因素，其破坏参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制。蛋白质L-异天冬氨酸O-甲基转移酶（PCMT）是进化上保守的蛋白质，通过修复异天冬氨酰残基和蛋白质质量控制途径参与受损蛋白质的识别与处理；然而，它们在ALS中的潜在作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们通过整合结构、转录组、单细胞、遗传和蛋白质建模分析，对PCMT家族（PCMT1、PCMTD1和PCMTD2）进行了全面的计算机表征。结构域分析表明，这三种蛋白质均共享一个保守的PCMT结构域，而预测的S-腺苷甲硫氨酸结合基序在PCMT1和PCMTD2中被识别，但在PCMTD1中未被识别，表明进化保守性伴随功能分化。表达谱分析显示，PCMT家族基因在ALS相关组织中表达，并在健康和ALS相关脑单细胞数据集中广泛分布于神经元、胶质、血管和免疫细胞群体。对多个独立ALS转录组队列的分析发现PCMT家族成员一致上调，其中PCMTD1在神经系统组织和外周血中表现出最可重复的疾病相关表达变化。基因集相关性分析进一步揭示了PCMT表达与神经元通路之间的不同关系，PCMT1与轴突运输和突触信号传导呈正相关，而PCMTD1和PCMTD2则主要显示反向相关模式。在ALS患者中识别的罕见错义变异被预测会损害蛋白质功能并降低蛋白质稳定性，而结构建模提示若干替换可能破坏保守残基和局部蛋白质结构。总之，这些发现将PCMT家族确定为先前未被充分探索的ALS相关候选基因，并为未来研究其在神经元蛋白质稳态和神经退行性变中作用的机制研究提供了全面框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将进化保守的PCMT蛋白质修复家族与ALS蛋白质稳态联系起来，并提出PCMTD1作为跨队列可重复的候选基因，具有假设生成和后续转化验证价值。

items.title: Liposomal Delivery of a Riluzole-Butyric Acid Mutual Prodrug Enhances Neuroprotection and Cognitive Recovery in Experimental Alzheimer's Disease.
items.summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline, impaired synaptic signaling, and persistent neuroinflammation. Current therapies primarily provide symptomatic relief and have limited effects on disease progression. Riluzole, approved for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, exhibits neuroprotective effects through modulation of glutamatergic signaling, but its poor oral bioavailability limits its therapeutic potential. Butyric acid, a short-chain fatty acid postbiotic produced by gut microbial fermentation, possesses well-established anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties. In this study, a mutual prodrug of riluzole and butyric acid was synthesized and encapsulated into liposomes to investigate its effects on drug distribution and preclinical efficacy. The prodrug-loaded liposomes exhibited an average particle size of 322 nm, zeta potential of -7.95 mV, and entrapment efficiency of 43.49%. Oral administration significantly improved cognitive performance and attenuated neuroinflammation and oxidative stress in an AlCl 3 -induced AD-like rat model. Administration of prodrug-loaded liposomes led to the highest concentrations of riluzole in brain homogenates among the relevant treatment groups. Overall, the prodrug-loaded liposomes demonstrated better therapeutic efficacy than the prodrug suspension, individual drug-loaded liposomes, and their respective conventional formulations. The enhanced therapeutic performance is attributed to the complementary pharmacological actions of riluzole and butyric acid, combined with the ability of the liposomal system to improve drug bioavailability and facilitate cerebral delivery.

items.titleZh: 利鲁唑-丁酸互前药脂质体递送在实验性阿尔茨海默病中增强神经保护与认知恢复
items.summaryZh: 该研究在AlCl3诱导的AD样大鼠模型中测试了一种利鲁唑-丁酸互前药脂质体。结果显示，口服该制剂可改善认知表现、减轻神经炎症和氧化应激，并提高脑内利鲁唑浓度；其疗效优于前药混悬液、单药脂质体及常规制剂。研究为临床前动物实验，尚不能推断对人体AD或ALS的疗效。
items.insight: 利鲁唑是ALS领域唯一广泛使用的谷氨酸调节药物，但其口服生物利用度低、脑内暴露有限。该研究通过互前药与脂质体递送策略同时改善利鲁唑的脑内递送并引入丁酸的抗炎作用，为ALS中“谷氨酸兴奋毒性+神经炎症”双重靶点干预提供了可借鉴的制剂学思路；不过其证据来自AD样大鼠模型，向ALS转化仍需专门验证。

items.abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，以认知衰退、突触信号受损和持续性神经炎症为特征。现有疗法主要提供症状缓解，对疾病进展影响有限。利鲁唑已获批用于肌萎缩侧索硬化，通过调节谷氨酸能信号发挥神经保护作用，但其口服生物利用度差限制了治疗潜力。丁酸是一种由肠道微生物发酵产生的短链脂肪酸后生元，具有明确的抗炎和神经保护特性。本研究合成了一种利鲁唑与丁酸的互前药，并将其包封于脂质体中，以考察其对药物分布和临床前疗效的影响。载前药脂质体的平均粒径为322 nm，zeta电位为-7.95 mV，包封率为43.49%。在AlCl3诱导的AD样大鼠模型中，口服给药显著改善了认知表现，并减轻了神经炎症和氧化应激。在相关治疗组中，给予载前药脂质体后脑匀浆中利鲁唑浓度最高。总体而言，载前药脂质体表现出优于前药混悬液、单药载脂质体及其各自常规制剂的治疗效果。治疗性能的增强归因于利鲁唑与丁酸的互补药理作用，以及脂质体系统提高药物生物利用度和促进脑内递送的能力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以利鲁唑-丁酸互前药脂质体同时靶向谷氨酸信号与神经炎症，并展示脑内递送增强，为ALS相关神经保护策略提供了新近的临床前转化线索。
